# eas performance

<!-- Generated by make bench-report from bench/baseline.json and bench/history.json; do not edit. -->

The standing performance suite (src/eas-perf.el).  A frame is one update (a push, a
timer tick, a pointermove, a resize, or opening a template) plus the redraw: the SVG
string, or the text grid patched into a buffer.  Calls per frame are
compiles/patches/scenes/renders/repaints.

`make bench-check` fails when bytes allocated per frame grow more than 10% or a
call count more than 0% over the baseline.  Wall-clock times are reported only.

```sh
make bench          # run the suite, compare with the baseline, never fail
make bench-check    # the regression gate (CI: byte-compiled)
make bench-record   # re-record bench/baseline.json, bench/history.json and this file
make bench-report   # regenerate this file from the committed baseline
```
